## Terms

spec—the feature's requirements to be built, packet—the complete result of a build including decisions, findings, and files, lanes—parallel build and verify execution paths that do not observe each other, convergence—merging lane results and running gates and repair loops, oracle—the verification suite that checks criteria without seeing implementation, workers—agents that write code and unit tests, integrator—combines worker output and writes integration tests, gates—quality checks that run against the build, rework round—iterative repair cycle to fix issues found in gates
